headline: BlueHalo boosts revenue, goodwill hit sinks profit
summary_short: AeroVironment's reported-quarter revenue was $642M, up 133.3% y/y on the BlueHalo acquisition, but net income swung to a $24M loss as a $240.7M non-cash goodwill impairment tied to the Space Force canceling the BADGER/SCAR contract offset the operating gains.
summary_long: FY2026 revenue rose 141% to $1,976.8M on the BlueHalo/ESAero acquisitions plus organic growth in legacy AV products (LMS, MacCready Works, MUAS), partly offset by lower SUAS international sales. Gross margin fell from 39% to 25% on purchase-accounting amortization and a mix shift to lower-margin acquired service revenue; SG&A rose on BlueHalo intangible amortization and headcount. A $240.7M non-cash goodwill impairment — from the Space Force canceling the BADGER/SCAR contract — swung the year from $43.6M net income to a $265.1M net loss. Cash ended the year at $377.3M plus $255.0M short-term investments; funded backlog grew to $1,183.0M from $726.6M. No dividend, buybacks, or forward guidance in this filing.

drivers.explanation: Fiscal-year revenue rose 141% to $1,976.8M, driven by $722.6M more product revenue and $433.6M more service revenue — the bulk from the BlueHalo/ESAero acquisitions, plus organic growth in legacy LMS, MacCready Works and MUAS lines, partly offset by lower SUAS international sales.

Gross profit dollars rose with revenue, but fiscal-year gross margin fell from 39% to 25% as $92.7M of purchase-accounting intangible amortization (vs $19.4M prior year) and a higher mix of lower-margin acquired service revenue outweighed volume gains.

Not broken out at the quarterly level in this annual filing. The disclosed FY2026 figure is a $311.0M full-year operating loss (from $40.8M income in FY2025), driven by the $240.7M Q4 goodwill impairment plus BlueHalo-related SG&A, R&D and amortization growth.

This quarter's swing to a $172.8M loss (from $14.1M positive) lines up with the $240.7M non-cash goodwill impairment the 10-K says was recorded during the fiscal fourth quarter (Space Force cancellation of the BADGER/SCAR contract).
Same dynamic as EBIT: the swing to a $110.7M loss this quarter aligns with the $240.7M goodwill impairment the filing states was recorded during the fiscal fourth quarter.

Swing to a quarterly net loss is consistent with the disclosed annual net loss of $265.1M (from $43.6M net income in FY2025), attributed to the $240.7M goodwill impairment plus a higher effective tax rate (7.5% vs 2.2%) from the non-deductible impairment.
